title: Scheme-relative and scheme-only resource URLs bypassed network admission checks

reproduction.beforeFix: The registry gate returned pass for protocol-relative media/resource attributes and for scheme-only HTTP(S) URLs in React/DOM forms.
reproduction.browserEvidence: Chromium on an HTTP preview origin requested http://collector.invalid/pixel for //collector.invalid/pixel and https://collector.invalid/pixel for https:collector.invalid/pixel. Playwright intercepted and aborted both requests before network access.

rootCause: Resource-attribute checks used a strict /^https?:\/\// expression, unlike the broadened CSS check, and did not inspect every srcset candidate.
remediation: Use one normalized HTTP(S)/scheme-relative classifier for resource attributes, reflected DOM mutations, resource constructors, module/network URL arguments, and each candidate in srcset.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "scheme-relative and scheme-only forms"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: JSX img src=//collector.invalid/pixel returned pass
validation.targetedAfterFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "scheme-relative and scheme-only forms"
validation.targetedAfterFixResult: passed; JSX, React factory, DOM property, setAttribute, Object.assign, and later srcset candidates are rejected

runtimeBoundary: Static source admission plus a browser URL-loading probe with collector.invalid requests intercepted and aborted. Deployed CSP verification remains pending.
